description: # MCDashboard plugin [![License: AGPL-3.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-AGPL--3.0-blue.svg)](https://github.com/MVdWSoftware/mcdashboard-plugin/blob/main/LICENSE) A Spigot/Paper plugin that publishes an allowlist of [PlaceholderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/) values over HTTPS with a live feed, so the MCDashboard mobile app can show live server stats. Only placeholders you list in `placeholders.yml` are ever resolved, and nothing is exposed until you turn it on. - Java 17, Spigot or Paper 1.18+, PlaceholderAPI on the server (Bedrock: see below). No other runtime dependencies: the HTTP server, WebSocket and JSON are the JDK's own. - HTTPS built in (self-signed or your own certificate), pairing with one-time codes and QR maps, signed tokens, per-device revocation, rate limits. - Optional history for charts, in memory or in SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB or PostgreSQL with a SOSA/SSN schema ([docs/history.md](https://github.com/MVdWSoftware/mcdashboard-plugin/blob/main/docs/history.md)). - Optional reverse tunnel and caching proxy support ([MCDashboard-proxy](https://github.com/MVdWSoftware/mcdashboard-proxy)). ## Install 1. Install PlaceholderAPI and the expansions you need. 2. Download `MCDashboard.jar` and put it in `plugins/`, or build it yourself (below). 3. Start the server once, review `plugins/MCDashboard/config.yml` ([reference](https://github.com/MVdWSoftware/mcdashboard-plugin/blob/main/docs/configuration.md)) and `placeholders.yml`, set `server.enabled: true`. 4. The plugin serves HTTPS itself (a self-signed certificate it generates, or your own); behind a TLS-terminating reverse proxy set `server.tls.mode: off`. Full guide: [docs/installation.md](https://github.com/MVdWSoftware/mcdashboard-plugin/blob/main/docs/installation.md). ## Configuration skills (AI agents) The plugin writes six skills to `plugins/MCDashboard/.agents/skills/` (setup, configuration, placeholders, dashboards, networks, troubleshooting): Markdown instructions an AI agent (Claude Code, OpenCode, ...) loads when it helps with this server, each ending with the matching pages on [mcdashboard.org](https://mcdashboard.org/en/docs/). They are refreshed on update; see [docs/skills.md](https://github.com/MVdWSoftware/mcdashboard-plugin/blob/main/docs/skills.md). ## Bedrock (PowerNukkitX) `MCDashboard-Nukkit.jar` is the same plugin for [PowerNukkitX](https://powernukkitx.org) 3 (Java 21), using the [PlaceholderAPI for PowerNukkitX](https://powernukkitx.org/plugins/PowerNukkitX-Bundle.PlaceholderAPI). Install both jars, then follow the steps above. Differences: [docs/bedrock.md](https://github.com/MVdWSoftware/mcdashboard-plugin/blob/main/docs/bedrock.md). ## Network (Velocity / BungeeCord) `MCDashboard-Velocity.jar` and `MCDashboard-Bungee.jar` put one dashboard on the whole network. Proxies have no PlaceholderAPI, so they publish built-in network placeholders (players online, per server online and up/down, uptime, version, the paired player's ping) and can optionally read the values of backend servers that run MCDashboard. Details and limits: [docs/proxy-platforms.md](https://github.com/MVdWSoftware/mcdashboard-plugin/blob/main/docs/proxy-platforms.md). ## Build ```sh mvn -B verify # spigot/target/MCDashboard.jar, nukkit/target/MCDashboard-Nukkit.jar, # velocity/target/MCDashboard-Velocity.jar, bungee/target/MCDashboard-Bungee.jar ``` `mvn -B verify` also runs JaCoCo (`/target/site/jacoco/index.html`) and fails below the per-module limits in each `pom.xml`; the limits only go up. `core/` holds everything that does not depend on a server platform (the API, authentication, history, tunnel and dashboards; JDK only). `spigot/` and `nukkit/` are the Spigot/Paper and PowerNukkitX plugins around it; `velocity/` and `bungee/` are the proxy plugins, sharing `proxy-common/`. Each shades `core/` into its jar. ## Documentation [docs/](https://github.com/MVdWSoftware/mcdashboard-plugin/blob/main/docs/README.md) covers installation, configuration, the security model, placeholders, dashboards, history, events and the tunnel. The API is described in [openapi.yaml](https://github.com/MVdWSoftware/mcdashboard-plugin/blob/main/openapi.yaml). To contribute, read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/MVdWSoftware/mcdashboard-plugin/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md); report vulnerabilities as described in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/MVdWSoftware/mcdashboard-plugin/blob/main/SECURITY.md). ## Terms and privacy The plugin's source code is licensed under the GNU AGPL v3 ([LICENSE](https://github.com/MVdWSoftware/mcdashboard-plugin/blob/main/LICENSE)). Using the MCDashboard app and the MCDashboard licence service is governed by the [terms of service](https://mcdashboard.org/en/terms-of-service/) and the [privacy statement](https://mcdashboard.org/en/privacy-statement/). Two things leave the server, and neither carries server names, addresses, player names or placeholder values: opt-in error reports (`diagnostics.error-reports`, default `false`) and anonymous [bStats](https://bstats.org) usage metrics (Spigot, Bungee and Velocity jars; turn off in `plugins/BStats/config.yml`). Details: [docs/configuration.md](https://github.com/MVdWSoftware/mcdashboard-plugin/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#diagnostics). ## Concepts - **Placeholders**: only entries of `placeholders.yml` are resolved; a `catalog:` offers a whole PlaceholderAPI expansion, `IMAGE` and `LIST` types carry pictures and tables ([docs/placeholders.md](https://github.com/MVdWSoftware/mcdashboard-plugin/blob/main/docs/placeholders.md)). - **Dashboards**: one YAML file each in `dashboards/`, permission derived from the file name; developers can upload from the app ([docs/dashboards.md](https://github.com/MVdWSoftware/mcdashboard-plugin/blob/main/docs/dashboards.md)). - **Update method and limits**: polling, live feed, refresh intervals, allowed clients and request limits ([docs/configuration.md](https://github.com/MVdWSoftware/mcdashboard-plugin/blob/main/docs/configuration.md), [docs/security.md](https://github.com/MVdWSoftware/mcdashboard-plugin/blob/main/docs/security.md)). - **Device events** tell a caching proxy about revocations ([docs/events.md](https://github.com/MVdWSoftware/mcdashboard-plugin/blob/main/docs/events.md)).
